description: Open the iOS-style iPadian home screen with app icons, a dock, App Store, Create, and My Apps. After opening, briefly explain in chat that users can tap apps, browse App Store for ready-made apps or choose Create for examples, or ask your assistant to build and revise their own web app. Explain that Save locally keeps app code in this browser, not runtime progress. This tool cannot read the local library.
